title: Pemimpin Bangsa sing Ditunjuk
intro: Ing wektu kang kebak tantangan lan rasa putus asa kanggo sawijining umat, sawijining janji suci wis digawe. Individu iki, sing wiwitane dilalekake dening akeh wong, dipilih dening Allah kanggo mimpin sawijining bangsa nglawan mungsuh sing kuat. Kisahe minangka bukti kekuwatan iman lan kawicaksanan ing mburi prentahe Allah, sing nuduhake yen kepemimpinan sejati ora mesthi ditemokake ing panggonan sing dikarepake.
clues: Aku dipilih déning Allah dadi pamimpin kanggo umatku nalika padha nggolèki pamimpin kanggo perang ing dalané.
Wong-wongku wiwitane mempertanyakan pengangkatanku, amarga rumangsa wong liya luwih pantes amarga kasugihane utawa keturunane.
Tandha saka kepemimpinanku sing sah yaiku baline peti suci, sing isine peninggalan saka para nabi sadurunge, sing nggawa katentreman.
Aku mimpin pasukanku menyang kali, ing ngendi aku nguji kepatuhane kanthi nglarang dheweke ngombe luwih saka sak sendok banyu.
Senajan cacahé sithik wong sing tetep teguh sawisé pacoban, kita ngadhepi prajurit sing gagah prakosa lan bala tentarané.
Ing sangisore komandoku, sawijining wong enom saka tentaraku, sing dudu pejuang kondhang, kanthi wani ngadhepi lan ngalahake jawara mungsuh sing tangguh.

outcome.label: Asil
options: Kerajaan diadegaké kanthi kasugihan lan kekuasaan sing gedhé banget.
Wong-wong padha klelep ing banjir gedhe.
Jawara mungsuhe kalah, lan Allah maringi kamenangan.
Kekeringan gedhe ngganggu tanah kasebut nganti pirang-pirang taun.
Pamimpin mau diuntal dening makhluk gedhe.
outcome.answer: Jawara mungsuhe kalah, lan Allah maringi kamenangan.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
